items.title: US launches new strikes against Iran after Trump warns country will pay for deaths of American soldiers
items.description: The United States launched a fresh round of attacks against Iran late on Monday in the tenth consecutive night of attacks. On Tuesday morning, Iran's Revolutionary guard said it had hit US military targets in Bahrain and Kuwait.

items.title: Why so many Ukrainians are up in arms over firing of defense minister
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s dismissal of the popular defense minister, an architect of Ukraine’s effective high-tech warfare, has sparked protests across the country. More than just strategy, youth appears part of his appeal.

items.title: How will Zelenskyy handle the growing political crisis at home?
items.description: Ukraine strikes Russian oil sites after major missile attack, as President Zelenskyy faces crisis over sacked minister.

items.title: Sale la tensione nel Golfo, embargo Houthi contro Riad
items.description: Spunta l'ipotesi tregua tra Usa e Iran, i mediatori propongono 10 giorni per un accordo

items.title: Russia says bus strike kills 5 in border region with Ukraine
items.description: The strike comes as Ukraine launched more than hundreds of drones at Moscow after a Russian missile barrage on Kyiv, as President Zelenskyy sought to calm growing tensions over Ukraine’s military leadership.

items.title: Ukraine fires 400 missiles at Moscow after deadly Russian attacks
items.description: Ukraine fired more than 400 drones toward Moscow in its latest major attack on the Russian capital on July 20. The blitz came hours after Russia bombarded Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities with ballistic missiles in a relentless cycle of tit-for-tat strikes.

items.title: What We Know About the Aftermath of Ukraine’s Wildberries Drone Strikes
items.description: The strikes, one of the costliest attacks on Russia’s commercial infrastructure since the start of the war, hit small businesses especially hard.

items.title: U.S. and Iran launch new strikes after 3 U.S. service members are killed
items.description: The U.S. attacks were the ninth consecutive day of bombing since peace talks between the two countries collapsed in dispute over a memorandum of understanding focused on the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: US soldier killed and one injured after Iranian attack in Iraq
items.description: The US military reports another death a day after two of its soldiers were killed in Jordan.

items.title: Ukraine: UN condemns overnight attack on Kyiv
items.description: United Nations agencies have deplored a fresh Russian assault on the Ukrainian capital Kyiv which left at least one person dead and a dozen injured.

items.title: Russia Hits Kyiv In Massive Missile And Drone Attack
items.description: Russia launched 41 missiles and 125 drones in a massive overnight attack on Ukraine, with Kyiv as the main target. Ukrainian officials said it was Russia's largest use of ballistic missiles since the start of the full-scale invasion. At least one person was killed and 16 were injured.

items.title: Russian Strike on Kharkiv Suburbs Kills Three, Injures 20
items.description: Russian forces attacked the suburbs of Kharkiv on Sunday, July 19, resulting in three civilian deaths and 20 people injured.
